verdict.rationale: Companies House is a public company register with a web search service and a REST API, so AI-generated insights or suggestions over its data are a plausible capability to ask about. However, nothing in the evidence describes any AI-powered insight, summarisation or recommendation feature. The documented features are search, filing, viewing records, following companies and raw API data access. Raw data access is only a building block a developer could use, so it earns no credit.
